انتفعوا (form VIII)
# اِنْتَفَعُوا (intafaʕū) /in.ta.fa.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْتَفَعَ (intafaʕa)
# اِنْتَفِعُوا (intafiʕū) /in.ta.fi.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْتَفَعَ (intafaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
